hook.say: Istanbul, the city on two continents. Five questions, three seconds each. Can you get the last one?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: By what name was Istanbul long known in the West?
questions.say: By what name was Istanbul long known in the West?
questions.fact: Before that it was Byzantium. Istanbul became the official name in 1930.
questions.sayAnswer: Constantinople! Before that it was Byzantium. Istanbul became the official name in 1930.

questions.q: Which emperor built Hagia Sophia, completed in 537?
questions.say: Which emperor built Hagia Sophia, completed in the year 537?
questions.fact: It was built in less than six years, starting in 532.
questions.sayAnswer: Justinian the First! It was built in less than 6 years, starting in 532.

questions.q: Which Istanbul tower was built by the Genoese in 1348?
questions.say: Which Istanbul tower was built by the Genoese in 1348?
questions.fact: Galata Tower was first called the Tower of Christ.
questions.sayAnswer: Galata Tower! It was first called the Tower of Christ.

questions.q: About how many shops fill Istanbul's Grand Bazaar?
questions.say: About how many shops fill Istanbul's Grand Bazaar?
questions.fact: The Grand Bazaar has 61 covered streets and over 4,000 shops.
questions.sayAnswer: Four thousand! The Grand Bazaar has 61 covered streets and more than 4000 shops.

questions.q: Istanbul's Tünel is the world's second-oldest subway. When did it open?
questions.say: Istanbul's Tunel is the world's second-oldest subway. When did it open?
questions.fact: It opened in 1875. Only London's Underground is older.
